plugins.description: Every AI coding agent running in your panes: which are working, and which are waiting for you.
A history of what you copied, pasted back into a pane or copied again from a list.
Write a prompt or a long command in your editor, and have it typed into the pane you were in.
vim's quickfix list for any pane: compiler errors from the screen and scrollback, opened in your editor at their line.
Run the focused pane's repository gate, its pre-commit checks, with one key, and badge the pane with the result.
The focused pane's git branch and changes in the bar, and a folder of git keys: status, lazygit, copy the branch or SHA, open the remote.
Search a pane's scrollback by regex, pick a match, and jump to it.
kizuna's running agents as pane badges and a bar count, with a picker to focus or message one.
The Kanban board of the repository you are in, from Kumiko: a picker, a board screen and a bar module. Read-only.
Rest the pointer on a link in any pane and see where it goes.
Jump between a pane's prompts, copy a command's output or its command line, and list the commands in the scrollback with their exit status.
A desktop notification, a toast and a pane badge when a long command finishes, or one fails, where you are not looking.
Ctrl+click a path or a link to open it: files in your editor, folders in a file manager, links in the browser.
The dev servers running across your panes, badged with their ports, to focus, open or copy.
Named scratch programs, each toggled in and out of a float by a key of its own.
Pick a project directory and go to its workspace, or open one: tmux-sessionizer for ranma.
Saved shell commands with placeholders, typed into the focused pane.
One pane with nothing around it, and everything put back after.
